quests.instruction: You are handing over the packing station to the next shift. Describe what is finished, what is still to do, and what needs attention. Start with the work that is still to do.
quests.hint: Say what is finished, then what is not, then the one thing that needs attention.
quests.explanation: A handover has a clear structure (done, not done, needs attention), and the learner practices stating each in order.
quests.sceneText: Packing Station|pallet of packed boxes|unpacked orders in a bin|label printer with a red light
quests.sampleAnswer: The packed boxes are stacked on the pallet on the left, so those are finished. The orders still in the bin on the right haven't been packed yet, and the label printer has a red light on, so it needs attention.
options: Label printer with a red light
acceptedSynonyms: unpacked orders,orders in a bin,bin of orders
label printer,printer with a red light,printer

quests.instruction: You are leaving the front desk. Tell the next person what they should know, in order of importance.
quests.hint: Start with the most important item, then the other two.
quests.explanation: Prioritizing information for someone taking over is a real workplace skill: the learner leads with the item that needs action.
quests.sceneText: Front Desk at Shift End|keys on labeled hooks|visitor log open on the desk|package waiting for pickup
quests.sampleAnswer: The most important thing is the package waiting for pickup on the shelf behind the desk. The visitor log is open on the desk, and all the keys are on their labeled hooks.
options: Visitor log open on the desk
acceptedSynonyms: visitor log,log on the desk,sign-in book

quests.instruction: Describe the salon at closing time and flag anything the next person must deal with.
quests.hint: Flag the item that needs action first, then say where the rest is.

quests.sceneText: Salon at Closing|hair dryer still plugged in|basket of used towels|appointment book open
quests.sampleAnswer: One hair dryer is still plugged in, so it needs to be switched off. The towels are in a basket by the sink, and the appointment book is open on the counter.
acceptedSynonyms: hair dryer,dryer still plugged in,blow dryer

quests.sceneText: Laptop Display|slim laptop with a silver case|ports along the left side|backlit keyboard

quests.instruction: A customer asks how this coffee machine works. Describe the parts in the order of use. End with the part used for milk.

quests.instruction: A customer asks how this tent is built. Describe the main parts and how they fit together. End with the door.

quests.instruction: You call reception to report problems in your room. Describe them clearly, in order of urgency. Start with the problem about the temperature.
quests.hint: Start with the most urgent problem, then the others.

quests.sampleAnswer: The air conditioner has a light blinking, and it isn't cooling. The remote has no batteries, so I can't change the settings, and the window won't open either.

acceptedSynonyms: air conditioner,air conditioner with a light,AC
quests.correctAnswer: Air conditioner with a blinking light

quests.instruction: Explain to a fellow traveler how to find your seat using the ticket and signs.

quests.sampleAnswer: My ticket says carriage six, seat fourteen. The carriage number sign is above the door, and each seat has a small reserved label.

reserved seat,seat with a label,reserved label

quests.instruction: You are visiting from abroad. Explain to a friend which line to join and what to do first.
quests.hint: Say which sign applies, then the first step, then what comes next.

quests.sampleAnswer: We're visitors, so we should join the line under the 'visitors' sign on the right. First, scan your passport at the kiosk, then wait for the next free booth.

quests.instruction: Present a student's project board: what the experiment seems to be about, and what each part shows. Start with the subject of the experiment.

quests.sceneText: Project Display|poster with results|measuring jar with water|plant growing in a pot
quests.sampleAnswer: This project seems to be about plant growth. The poster shows results in a chart, the jar next to it measures the water, and the plant in the pot is the main subject.
acceptedSynonyms: plant in a pot,growing plant,potted plant

quests.sceneText: Closed Play Area|warning tape across a swing set|sign asking people to stay away|children playing nearby
quests.sampleAnswer: One swing is broken, and warning tape is stretched across the whole set. A sign asks people to stay away, but several children are playing close by.

quests.sampleAnswer: The pedestrian signal is dark, and it's not showing anything. Several people are waiting at the curb, and cars are slowing down at the crossing.
acceptedSynonyms: pedestrians waiting,people at the curb,people waiting

quests.instruction: Report to the city department what is wrong with the street light.
quests.hint: Say what is wrong, what is hanging, and what is nearby.
quests.explanation: A report to the city includes the problem, the hazard, and what is nearby that could be affected.
quests.sceneText: Leaning Lamp Post|leaning lamp post|hanging cables|parked car nearby
quests.sampleAnswer: A lamp post is leaning to one side at a steep angle. Some cables are hanging down from it, and a car is parked close by, so it could be dangerous.

quests.instruction: Explain this flowchart to a colleague who can't see it: start, decision point, and end. Spend the most time on the decision point.
quests.hint: Start with where the flow begins, then the decision, then what the red notes are.

quests.sceneText: Whiteboard Flowchart|boxes joined by arrows|diamond with Yes and No branches|red notes at the side
quests.sampleAnswer: The flow starts at a box on the left, with arrows leading to the right. In the middle there's a diamond where it splits into 'Yes' and 'No', and the notes in red at the side are corrections.
options: Diamond with Yes and No branches
acceptedSynonyms: boxes and arrows,boxes joined by arrows,flow boxes
red notes,notes at the side,red writing
quests.correctAnswer: Diamond with Yes and No branches

quests.instruction: Describe the project timeline chart: how it is laid out, and what shows the current date.

quests.explanation: The learner explains a timeline chart (bars, milestones, today line), which is a common visual in a project meeting.
quests.sceneText: Project Timeline|bars across the weeks|diamond milestone markers|vertical line marking today
quests.sampleAnswer: The weeks run across the top, and each task has a bar. Diamonds mark milestones, and a vertical line shows today, so the bars to its left are shaded.

quests.instruction: Describe the trade fair hall in seven to nine sentences: overview, layout, flow of people, and a tip for newcomers. End with the tip about the map.
quests.hint: Start with the overview, then the booths, the people, the map, the entrance, and finish with a tip.
quests.explanation: Level 180 completes the advanced block: the learner gives a long, organized description with an overview, layout, flow, and advice, as a fluent speaker would.
quests.sceneText: Trade Fair Hall|booths with banners overhead|visitors wearing badges|aisle with a floor map
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a large trade fair hall, with rows of booths on both sides of a wide central aisle. Banners hang from the ceiling above each booth, so you can see the company names from far away. Visitors wearing badges are walking in both directions, and some are stopping to talk at the booths. In the middle of the aisle, a floor map stands on a stand with a 'You are here' marker. Near the entrance, a registration desk has a short line. At the back, a stage has a small group watching a demonstration. For newcomers, the best thing is to look at the floor map first and then plan a route.
acceptedSynonyms: visitors with badges,visitors wearing badges,people with badges
floor map,map in the aisle,aisle map

quests.instruction: Describe the campus quad in seven to nine sentences: overview, layout, people, activities, and a tip. Start with the left side of the quad.
quests.hint: Start with the overall scene, then the left, the middle, the right, the far end, and finish with a tip.
quests.explanation: The learner covers an overview, several areas, a far end, and advice, all connected with transitions, as in a real spoken description.
quests.sceneText: University Quad|food trucks along the road|students sitting on the lawn|bike racks near the library
quests.sampleAnswer: This is the central quad of a university at lunchtime. Along the road on the left, three food trucks have lines of students waiting. In the middle of the quad, students are sitting on the lawn in small groups, some eating and some studying. On the right, bike racks near the library are almost full. A path crosses the lawn diagonally, and people are walking in both directions. At the far end, a clock tower stands in front of the main building. If you want a quiet spot, the benches under the trees on the right are the least crowded.
acceptedSynonyms: food trucks,trucks along the road,food vans
students on the lawn,students sitting,people on the lawn
bike racks,racks near the library,bicycle racks

quests.instruction: Describe the museum hall in seven to nine sentences: overview, layout, people, what is most impressive, and a tip for visitors.
quests.hint: Start with the overview, then the main attraction, the people, the back, the entrance, and a tip.
quests.explanation: The learner combines overview, main attraction, people, and advice in a connected description that sounds like a real museum visit.
quests.sceneText: Train Museum Hall|visitors reading plaques|vintage locomotive in the center|model railway at the back
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a large museum hall dedicated to trains. The vintage locomotive in the center is the main attraction: it's black and red, with huge wheels, and it sits on a short track. Visitors are walking around it, and several are reading the plaques at its side. On the left, a family is looking at a display case of old tickets. At the back, a model railway fills a long table, and a small crowd is watching the tiny trains run. Near the entrance, a person is handing out maps. If you are short on time, start with the locomotive, and then go to the model railway.
acceptedSynonyms: model railway,model trains,railway at the back
